literature_notes: NETO1 is a type I single-pass transmembrane protein (SP 1-22, ectodomain 23-343, TM 344-363, cytoplasmic tail 364-533). All five ledger lines describe tags on the intracellular C-terminus or on soluble truncation constructs lacking the TM domain. L1 and L2 (PMC2652390) describe Neto1-Δ20HA, in which two HA copies replace the C-terminal 20 residues (514-533) and are therefore appended after residue 513, which is intracellular (residue 513 = Q, topology I). L3, L4, and L5 (PMC5494894) describe NETO1-HA, an in-frame HA tag added to the C-terminus of full-length NETO1 (after residue 533 = V), also intracellular. The truncation constructs in L1 (Neto1-ΔcytoTM-eGFP 1-340, Neto1 CUB12-eGFP 1-290, Neto1 CUB1-eGFP 1-162) carry eGFP at the C-terminus of an ectodomain fragment with no TM anchor — these are soluble ectodomain constructs secreted as separate proteins and are explicitly disqualified. Neto1-Δcyto-eGFP (1-363) terminates at the last TM residue (V363) and is not an extracellular surface tag. No ledger line supports an insertion at the mature N-terminus (after residue 22) or anywhere in the extracellular domain (23-343) of a full-length, membrane-anchored NETO1 construct. Zero sites qualify.

literature_other_positions.note: Neto1-Δ20HA inserts two HA copies after residue 513 (Q), replacing the C-terminal 20 aa (514-533); residue 513 is within the intracellular tail (364-533).
NETO1-HA appends an in-frame HA tag after the final residue 533 (V) of full-length NETO1; the C-terminus is intracellular (364-533).
